implemented: Versioned offline backup bundles preserve caller-declared dependency paths and verify file hashes, lengths, and path safety.
Daily paper evidence bundles require the account close archive, paper-account journal, and forward-runner journal.

The daily bundle verifier replays the account journal, binds its sequence and head to the EOD archive, compares OMS/account state and reconciled returns, and reproduces the operator report from exported inputs.
Restored bundles can be copied to an isolated location and verified without the source tree.
A single local daily-finalize CLI command reconstructs the account and performs close plus verified bundle export from explicit owner-supplied marks and durable session evidence.
blockers: Automatic discovery and packaging of observed quote archives, strategy/configuration inputs, registry and authority state, and all other runtime dependencies are not wired.
No end-to-end restore drill has reconstructed and resumed a complete owner-authorized observed market session.
